description: Wittig reaction of anisaldehyde 1 with Ph3P=CHCOMe 2 at 67 C (Chen, Nieves-Quinones, Waas, Singleton, JACS 2014): 4-TS and 6-TS in series, weighted by the trajectories, 128 of which go on to product for 76 that return (C_f = 128/76). Labels: anisaldehyde, ylide, 4-TS, 6-TS. The carbonyl carbon is relative to a meta carbon of the ring (anisaldehyde 6, TS 25) and the ylide carbons to the ketone methyl carbon, the experiment's standards.
